title: District Commission
description: Definition of District Commission under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission established under sub-section (1) of section 28
content.plain_language: a local government body that helps resolve consumer complaints at the district level
examples: A consumer files a complaint against a company in the District Commission of Delhi
A District Commission in Mumbai hears a case against a defective product manufacturer

user_queries: How to file a complaint in District Commission?
What is the role of District Commission in consumer protection?
